smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001606751.text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
**Primary Responsibilities:**
Diagnose vehicle systems independently using various testers and diagnostic tools
Troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic, and mechanical systems in vehicles
Create content for guided troubleshooting procedures and documentation
Research and create high-quality, informative, and engaging automotive content using different authoring tools
Diagnose electronic, mechanical, and electrical systems problems in vehicles using different testers and diagnostic tools
Identify and understand Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) and specific error codes generated by vehicle systems
Conduct vehicle testing, including individual component testing using automotive testing and diagnostic equipment such as OBD-II scanners, multimeters, and oscilloscopes
Demonstrate strong knowledge of Gasoline, Diesel, Comfort & Safety systems with detailed understanding of sensor and actuator workflows
Understand automotive electrical system wiring diagrams, wire color codes, connectors, components, and their functionalities, including symbols and DIN standards
Maintain detailed documentation records of system tests, removal & refit procedures, and results for reference and guidelines
Demonstrate familiarity with tools, equipment, and procedures related to removal and refit to create informative and instructional content
Qualifications
BE/ B. Tech/ ME/ M. Tech- Automobile/Mechanical
Additional Information
3 to 6 Years

smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001606756.title: Automotive Systems Diagnostic and troubleshooting Engineer (Grade X & OTX/ODX)
smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001606756.text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Role Overview
We are seeking an Automotive Systems Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Engineer to diagnose vehicle systems independently, troubleshoot and repair electrical systems, and create comprehensive guided troubleshooting content for automotive applications.
Core Responsibilities
Diagnose electronic, mechanical, and electrical system problems in vehicles using industry-standard testers and diagnostic tools, including OBD-II scanners, multimeters, and oscilloscopes
Identify and interpret Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) to understand specific error codes and determine root causes
Conduct comprehensive vehicle testing, including individual component testing and system validation
Create high-quality, informative, and engaging automotive diagnostic content using various authoring tools
Develop guided troubleshooting procedures and instructional materials based on hands-on diagnostic experience
Technical Expertise Required
Demonstrate strong knowledge of Gasoline, Diesel, Comfort, and Safety systems, including detailed workflow and operation of sensors and actuators
Understand automotive electrical system wiring diagrams, wire color codes, connectors, components, and their functionalities, including symbols and DIN standards
Apply proficiency with tools, equipment, and procedures related to component removal and refit to create informative instructional content
Maintain detailed documentation of system tests, removal and refit procedures, and results for reference and organizational guidelines
Preferred Qualifications
 
Experience with OE testers and OE descriptions
Knowledge of OBD-II standards and guided troubleshooting methodologies
Familiarity with Hybrid and Electric Vehicle (HV/EV) systems
Relevant certification in Automotive Mechatronics
Hybrid and Electric Vehicle Systems certification (Level 2 and Level 3)
Qualifications
BE/ B. Tech/ ME/ M. Tech- Automobile/Mechanical
Additional Information
3 to 13 Years
